title: 第二十六章 这护卫哪找的第二十七章 诛魔
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
尝试着劝了两句之后，方明轩还是决定要跟着一起下去。
他心意已决，方书文也无话可说。
心中打定主意，下去之后不能叫这老头冒险。
之后又有人跳出来，要跟着一起下去。
方书文觉得下面情况未知，人数不宜过多，万一施展不开，人多反而累赘。
索性就让他们等在上面。
将外面的事情大概的安排好了之后，方书文一行四人来到了那入口，沿着台阶往下。
行不多时，方书文的耳朵里就听到了一阵阵哭声。
这是女子的哭声。
方书文的眼睛微微眯起，却并未多言，这台阶很长，又走了一段之后，周青梅他们也能够听到声音了。
脸色都是微微变化。
方书文加快脚步，终于来到了这青阳庄的地下世界。
打眼一扫，正跟两个黑袍男子来了个六目相对。
下一刻，这两个人猛然反应过来，双眼圆瞪，正要开口惊呼。
方书文已然凌空而起，一招【金刚掷塔】人在半空，掌风便已经轰然击下，掌势瞬间将两个人覆盖其中。
就听得两声闷响。
那掌力自天灵而至，生生将他们打入地下半截，好似插秧一般，种在了地里。
各自七窍流血，死在当场。
“好刚猛的掌法！”
方明轩眸中带着异色

“方小兄弟，年纪轻轻就有这般武功，着实叫人钦佩。”
“不敢不敢。”
方书文摆了摆手，他其实挺不喜欢跟这方明轩说话的。
这老头一口一个小兄弟的叫着，将来关系要是一直隐藏下去的话，倒也还好……可要是哪一天暴露出来，岂不是尴尬？
不过这个时候也没有什么机会和方明轩多做交谈。
一声声呼救的声音，从四面传来。
放眼望去，周围是一处处牢笼，里面关着的都是一些脸色惨白的姑娘。
方书文面色阴沉。
其实他来到广宁城之后，听到广宁城半年以来，发生了六起血案，心中便生出了一个疑问。
【黑煞魔功】修炼的方法是，在用来修炼的姑娘头顶百会穴上，开一个孔。
以掌心劳宫穴和这个孔相对，借魔功之中的秘法，引血而出，将血液之中的先天元阴引入体内，纳入气海之中。
之后再运功，将这气海之中的先天元阴，化为黑煞真气。
过程会中并未说过，一定要将这女子杀死才行。
完全可以在少女的头顶开个洞，练完之后，再将这伤势包扎，或者是抹上金疮药，待等下一次练功的时候，再将这创口撕开。
如此一来，便可以反复利用。
毕竟百会穴虽然是人身死穴之一，但只要力度合适，也未必会闹出人命。
只是如此一来，这些姑娘所承受的痛苦和折磨，就会更多，但至少可以保住性命。
可为什么广宁城里，会接连死这么多人？
如今看来，不是黑煞教的人没脑子，想不到这样的办法。
只是每个人做事的方法不同，那六起血案的始作俑者，或许只是不在乎而已。

所以他更加肆无忌惮，可以随意取命杀人。
而如今这些女子，则一直被黑煞教的人，当成随取随用的练功材料。
方书文没有立刻动手救人，而是让她们先且安静一会。
content_en:
After trying a few words of persuasion, Fang Mingxuan decided to go along.
He had made up his mind, and Fang Shuwen had nothing to say.
I made up my mind not to let this old man take risks after going down.
Then someone else jumped out and wanted to go down with him.
Fang Shuwen felt that the situation below was unknown, and the number of people should not be too large. If it could not be used, too many people would be a burden.
Just let them wait above.
After roughly arranging things outside, Fang Shuwen and his party came to the entrance and walked down the steps.
Not long after walking, Fang Shuwen heard bursts of crying in his ears.
This is the cry of a woman.
Fang Shuwen's eyes narrowed slightly, but he didn't say much. The steps were very long, and after walking for a while, Zhou Qingmei and the others could hear the sound.
His face changed slightly.
Fang Shuwen quickened his pace and finally arrived at the underground world of Qingyang Village.
Glancing around, I saw two men in black robes making eye contact.
The next moment, the two people reacted suddenly, their eyes widened, and they were about to scream.
Fang Shuwen had already risen into the air, and with a move of [Diamond Throwing Tower], the people were in mid-air, and the wind from his palm struck down with a crash, and the palm force instantly covered the two people.
Just two muffled sounds were heard.
The palm force came from the heavenly spirit, driving them half into the ground, like planting rice seedlings, planting them in the ground.
Their respective orifices were bleeding and they died on the spot.
"What a powerful palm technique!"
Fang Mingxuan had a strange look in his eyes
"Brother Fang, you have such martial arts skills at such a young age. It's really admirable."
"Don't dare."
Fang Shuwen waved his hand. He actually didn't like talking to Fang Mingxuan.
The old man shouted like a little brother. It would be fine if the relationship was kept hidden in the future... But wouldn't it be embarrassing if it were exposed one day?
However, there was no chance to talk to Fang Mingxuan at this time.
Voices calling for help came from all directions.
Looking around, there are cages all around, and some girls with pale faces are locked inside.
Fang Shuwen looked gloomy.
In fact, after he came to Guangning City, he heard that six murders had occurred in Guangning City in the past six months, and a question arose in his mind.
The method of practicing [Heisha Demonic Skill] is to make a hole in the Baihui point on the head of the girl who is being practiced.
Use the Laogong point in the palm of your hand to face this hole, and use the secret method in the magic technique to draw out the blood, introduce the innate Yuan Yin in the blood into the body, and incorporate it into the sea of ​​qi.
After that, he would use his kung fu to turn the innate Yuan Yin in this sea of ​​Qi into the Black Evil True Qi.
Nothing was said during the process that this woman must be killed.
You can make a hole in the girl's head, and after practicing, bandage the wound, or apply golden sore medicine, and then tear open the wound during the next practice.
This way, it can be used again and again.
After all, although the Baihui point is one of the fatal points of the human body, as long as the intensity is appropriate, it may not cause death.
Only in this way, these girls will suffer more pain and torture, but at least they can save their lives.
But why did so many people die one after another in Guangning City?
Now it seems that the people of Heisha Cult are not brainless and cannot think of such a method.
It's just that everyone has different ways of doing things. The initiator of those six murders may just not care.
Therefore, he is even more unscrupulous and can kill people at will.
Nowadays, these women have been used by the Heisha Cult as training materials that can be used at any time.
Fang Shuwen did not immediately rescue them, but asked them to be quiet for a while.
